rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass across all four views, with a clear dominant bent slab/plate gesture and a protected notch carving that produces a legible internal void. It is not a mere box: the plan-top view shows a real open figure rather than fill-to-boundary behavior, and the frontage edge is answered by a distinct seam/void condition instead of a sealed wall. The silhouette is coherent and mildly stepped rather than arbitrary tiering, so it supports neighborhood_living reasonably well. The main limitation is that the public void is useful but still somewhat modest and the section remains calm/flat rather than strongly articulated for daylit upper hierarchy; nevertheless, nothing indicates a typology mismatch or a view-dependent collision.
